analysis: Compare each candidate with its exact scan/label raw control. Recompute serialized PLY topology and occupancy volume independently from the archive, intake, and candidate receipt. Treat each scan-label surface as a geometry unit, not as an independent participant.

control.method: Previously retained raw voxel-boundary surfaces from the same source archive, scan, labels, and affine; no contact splitting.

method: CPU-only exact occupied-voxel-union surfaces; pair ordinary two-face edges by incidence and pair four-face edge contacts by their two source voxel owners, then split disconnected triangle-corner fans by vertex index only.

predictions_before_source_run.geometry: All triangle coordinate sequences, triangle counts, face winding, surface areas, and signed voxel-occupancy volumes are unchanged; independent relative volume error remains at most 1e-9.
predictions_before_source_run.source_archive_nifti_header_affine_label: All 12 labels reproduce from the pinned intake.
predictions_before_source_run.topology: All 12 candidate surfaces are closed two-manifolds. The 4 known defective labels in scan 001 and 8 in scan 002 become closed; the 8 already closed labels in scan 001 and 4 in scan 002 remain closed with zero cloned vertices.

purpose: Exploratory algorithm evaluation on already inspected source masks; the raw voxel-boundary artifacts are the matched controls.
stopping_and_exclusion_rules: Run one compile attempt per scan; do not retry failed or incomplete outputs under this plan.
A source identity, voxel-count, coordinate-sequence, volume, area, face-count, owner-pairing, or manifold failure refutes the corresponding prediction and remains recorded.

Do not smooth, interpolate, decimate, or edit voxel labels; do not promote a topology split to expert segmentation accuracy, Numi subject registration, physical tissue ownership, mechanics, physiology, or clinical anatomy.
